scope: First-version and original full-MVP gate reconciliation, not a completion claim

functional_requirements.acceptance: Desktop application consumes Vellum's public APIs from an independent Go application; both visible and headless clients use the same semantic operations; a recorded, reproducible SDK/dependency baseline builds on a clean supported development environment
functional_requirements.assessment: Partial: current-workstation builds and isolated copied runtime are proven; clean dependency bootstrap, supported account/OS installation and distribution remain unqualified

functional_requirements.acceptance: A user can construct the LED circuit from blank using visible controls without entering SPICE syntax or using a context menu
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented visible blank LED construction; novice discoverability still requires Gate D

functional_requirements.acceptance: Tests distinguish endpoints, explicit junctions, crossings, and near misses; moving a connected component preserves its net; invalid placement remains a preview until committed
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented within one sheet and existing bounds

functional_requirements.acceptance: `1k`, `2.2k`, `10 ms`, and `1 µF` parse into canonical values with visible units; ambiguous or invalid input is explained without changing the previous valid value; one undo restores each committed edit, including a complete slider drag
functional_requirements.assessment: Partial: time/waveform units and exact round-trip value drafts now work through shared commands/native committed fields; control-event tests plus one actual mounted paused slider drag/Undo prove a single commit/event/history entry and charge/time continuity; offscreen real-clock running/Tab-focus/interruption and agent-replay checks now pass; actual /174 paused/running drags and held-click agent-edit call now match packaged-agent state and independent RC references; exact physical interleaving, window blur, typing and IME coverage remain open

functional_requirements.acceptance: Mouse and keyboard can select parts/nets, inspect properties, pan, zoom, fit, and escape an unfinished operation without altering the circuit
functional_requirements.assessment: Partial: core drawing/history/file keyboard loop is exercised; complete mounted navigation/focus and assistive-technology scenarios remain unqualified

functional_requirements.acceptance: Completing or electrically editing a valid supported circuit triggers calculation without a separate Run step; drawing remains responsive while calculating
functional_requirements.assessment: Partial: real-capacity backend and functional native live-run evidence exists; native main-loop/visible-latency and broader difficult-topology qualification remain open

functional_requirements.acceptance: All actions follow the state contract below; traces from different electrical revisions are never joined into an apparently continuous result
functional_requirements.assessment: Partial: pending/coalescing/cancellation/provenance evidence exists; complete mounted gesture invalidation and state-table qualification remain open

functional_requirements.acceptance: Status uses text as well as color; simulated time and playback speed are visible; failure or lack of progress never becomes an apparently valid zero reading
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented behavior in tested families; interpretation with people remains pending

functional_requirements.acceptance: Default analysis passes the electrical acceptance suite; insufficient resolution, solver failure, or unsupported conditions are shown explicitly; the app never silently swaps to a simpler model to maintain speed
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented for the curated release reference suite on this workstation; broader PVT/waveform/device/SPICE qualification and other release gates remain separate

functional_requirements.acceptance: Verify accepts duration and initial conditions through ordinary controls, records engine/model/settings versions, and produces a reproducible result for the supported suite
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented within declared duration/step/storage envelope

functional_requirements.acceptance: Every palette part has a working model and correct pin mapping; its inspector identifies generic/ideal behavior and model limitations before a user relies on it
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented generic/ideal inventory; no physical parts/ratings claim

functional_requirements.acceptance: Selected and pinned readings expose units, sign convention, reference direction, and simulation status; a stale pin is visibly stale
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented for supported live probes/pins; full keyboard/screen-reader qualification remains in EDIT-04/ACCESS-01; captured-schematic interaction is future work

functional_requirements.acceptance: Animation can be disabled without losing information; polarity/current direction remains available numerically; LED brightness and moving dots are labeled as illustrative rather than calibrated physical rendering
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented explanatory cues; dots/LED brightness labeled illustrative; OS integration and complete accessibility remain unqualified

functional_requirements.acceptance: A selected node/component has labeled plot actions; up to four traces retain labels, units, and source associations; removing a source marks its trace unavailable
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented for selected live sources; recorded view suppresses current-schematic highlights; interactive captured-schematic highlighting is future work

functional_requirements.acceptance: Users can type cursor times, read values/deltas, and obtain min/max over a specified interval; the measurement shows its interval and does not silently include earlier startup history
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented sampled measurement behavior, shared unit-text time entry and optional captured-reference overlays with common axes; narrow-window endpoint cursor geometry repaired; full mounted interaction qualification remains in EDIT-03; RC manual input-edge repair qualified in /161, preserved /160 remains affected

functional_requirements.acceptance: Missing reference, disconnected required terminal, invalid parameter, missing/corrupt model, and nonconvergence each produce a relevant explanation; a known affected object is highlighted; no modal interrupts a temporary wire gesture
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented known-cause recovery guidance; unknown causes are not fabricated; accessibility/discoverability remain separate gates

functional_requirements.acceptance: All three examples open, run, explain one limitation, accept changes, and reset without modifying the original example
functional_requirements.assessment: Implemented guided editable examples/current reset; novice comprehension, accessibility and participant evidence remain separate gates

functional_requirements.acceptance: A project exported on one supported installation opens offline on a clean installation without fetching a model; unsupported newer formats open read-only when possible or fail clearly without rewriting the file

functional_requirements.acceptance: Writes are atomic; failed saves preserve the last valid project; recovery offers the newest complete autosave without replacing an explicitly saved file silently

functional_requirements.acceptance: SVG represents the visible schematic with readable labels; bounded-result CSV includes time, signal names, units, and result identity; exports preserve the source project

functional_requirements.acceptance: Clients can enumerate supported capabilities and versions, obtain typed input/output schemas, units, defaults, preconditions, and error codes, and inspect application/project state by stable IDs without screen scraping

quality_targets.proposed_target: At least 50 simulated components, 100 electrical nodes, and four traces using the curated library; publish the validated envelope and explain excess complexity without losing edit/save access
quality_targets.current_evidence: Named 51-part/100-node and 64-part/four-probe fixtures have functional and older repeated backend evidence; current /174 capacity suite passes.
quality_targets.remaining: Does not establish visible response at every topology or simultaneous maxima.

quality_targets.proposed_target: 95th-percentile visible acknowledgment within 100 ms for supported edits; measure input event to visible acknowledgment, independently of solver completion
quality_targets.current_evidence: 100 ms visible acknowledgment remains inconclusive; controller overhead is included in recorded upper bounds.
quality_targets.remaining: Needs a valid input-to-acknowledgment measurement method and declared observations; do not call these bounds a product failure.

quality_targets.proposed_target: 95th-percentile time from accepted edit to the first valid updated sample within 500 ms on the three reference circuits; show Updating until then
quality_targets.current_evidence: /173 full NPN and separate LED blocks support their named 500 ms target; RC blocks contain unavailable observations.
quality_targets.remaining: No complete RC percentile and no automatic transfer to /174; preserve failed IDs and untouched observations.

quality_targets.proposed_target: Complete the reference 200 ms transient runs within 2 seconds on the locked reference configuration; this is wall time for a bounded test, not a universal real-time promise
quality_targets.current_evidence: Older repeated suites separate zero-duration DC from 200 ms transient cases. Current /174 has three flasher refinement timings per adapter below 2 s.
quality_targets.remaining: No universal runtime guarantee or full new repeated current-build timing gate; native UI timing is separate.

quality_targets.proposed_target: A slow or failed solve must not block navigation, cancel, save, or undo; benchmark these actions under a deliberately difficult fixture
quality_targets.current_evidence: /141 backend command spans during actual capacity work and current source/copy integration retain their scopes.
quality_targets.remaining: Native visible interaction under difficult solve and wider topology qualification remain open.

quality_targets.proposed_target: Meet the tolerances in the release suite below with default settings; tighten numerical resolution without materially changing accepted measurements
quality_targets.current_evidence: Current /174 four-adapter electrical, coil/opamp/storage/capacity suites and native reference fixtures pass within declared generic models.
quality_targets.remaining: Do not infer physical-device accuracy, all PVT or general SPICE support; preserve explicit unsupported/failure envelopes.

quality_targets.proposed_target: Autosave complete committed changes within 5 seconds while storage is available; show save failure; fault-injection tests preserve the last successful manual save
quality_targets.current_evidence: /126 automatic recovery has 240 named-fixture samples under 5 s; /128 backend/descriptor failure/retry and /161 native crash/capture recovery retain their scopes.
quality_targets.remaining: Actual current native automatic storage warning persistence/readability while editing is not recorded; broad storage/power-loss remains unqualified.

quality_targets.proposed_target: Native save/open round-trip retains connectivity, values, models, probes, initial conditions, and recorded results across clean installations of the supported version
quality_targets.current_evidence: Current copied offline runtime, Unicode ZIP extraction and fresh saved-project reopens pass on this workstation.
quality_targets.remaining: Clean-account/default startup and ordinary installation are unperformed; owner deferral is private-alpha only.

quality_targets.proposed_target: No account or network dependency for the core workflow; project contents stay local unless the user explicitly exports or shares them; no mandatory telemetry
quality_targets.current_evidence: Core reference workflows run offline without account/provider; copied runtime uses outbound-IP and development-file denial.
quality_targets.remaining: Do not turn this recorded offline scope into a claim about new providers or future network features.

quality_targets.proposed_target: Status is understandable without color or motion; complete the core keyboard and screen-reader scenarios on the pilot platform; do not infer support from screenshots alone
quality_targets.current_evidence: Core keyboard, AX/control labels and narrow native focus/input cases have evidence.
quality_targets.remaining: Actual screen-reader core scenarios, full keyboard/focus/IME and participant interpretation remain open. No new OS permission is authorized.

quality_targets.proposed_target: 100% of shipped user capabilities covered by the public command/query catalog and conformance tests; no core workflow requires UI automation; both client paths obey the same numerical and state-contract acceptance criteria
quality_targets.current_evidence: 164 semantic annotations, 72-file/397-site ledger, reference four-adapter workflows and twelve job families are recorded.
quality_targets.remaining: 100% complete per-capability behavior/binding/state acceptance is not proven; 174 dynamic/relay/custom sites are not an untested-action count.

release_scenarios.required_result: Build from blank; measure current; change 1 kΩ to 2 kΩ and see a lower current automatically. With the specified educational diode model at 27 °C, the research reference is approximately 2.9168 mA at 1 kΩ. Require agreement within 1% against an independently computed or reference-solver result for the identical model; check KVL/KCL separately
release_scenarios.assessment: Current packaged reference result plus recorded native blank construction; owner/newcomer acceptance remains unperformed.

release_scenarios.required_result: 10 kΩ, 1 µF, 0–5 V pulse. For an ideal step, Vout at 10 ms is 3.160602794 V; account for finite source rise time. Require error within max(1 mV, 0.1% of reference magnitude) at predefined samples, and verify approximately 33.464 mV/4.966536 V periodic extrema using the matching stimulus
release_scenarios.assessment: Current independent ideal/finite/edge references and recorded native construction/measurements; all default cases remain scoped.

release_scenarios.required_result: Base through 10 kΩ, collector load 1 kΩ to 5 V. With `NPN(Is=1e-14 Bf=100)`, compare on/off states and transition timing against an independent reference. Research on-state reference is approximately 70.4 mV; proposed tolerance is max(1 mV, 1% of reference magnitude)
release_scenarios.assessment: Current pinned-model four-adapter suite and recorded actual native transistor workflows; not all real-device conditions.

release_scenarios.required_result: Exercise every state-contract row, including invalidating a paused circuit, undo, repeated slider edits, switch events, and deletion of a probe source; stale or cross-revision values are never presented as current
release_scenarios.assessment: Named source/public/native cases pass; exhaustive physical state-table/gesture schedules remain unqualified.

release_scenarios.required_result: Remove ground, miss a connection, enter an invalid value, corrupt a model dependency, and provoke nonconvergence. Verify truthful status, relevant explanation, retained work, and undo/recovery
release_scenarios.assessment: Named missing-ground/value/model/nonconvergence/save/crash tests exist; current native automatic storage warning is the next bounded gap.

release_scenarios.required_result: Reopen on a clean offline installation; rerun bounded verification; compare against the same tolerances; inspect native, SVG, and CSV output and recovery after interrupted writes
release_scenarios.assessment: Copied offline saves/exports and native file decisions pass in recorded scopes; clean-installation and broader interrupted-storage evidence remain open.

release_scenarios.required_result: Run a valid 50-component fixture with four traces, plus node-limit boundary cases; evaluate latency, cancellation, bounded history, and the keyboard/screen-reader path
release_scenarios.assessment: Named boundary/backend cases pass; visible difficult-solve and actual screen-reader core paths remain open.

release_scenarios.required_result: From an empty session, an external client creates each reference circuit, inspects models/connectivity, changes values, runs and measures it, fixes an introduced fault, saves/exports, closes, and reopens it without GUI input; repeat through the in-process interface and compare semantic project state and results
release_scenarios.assessment: Current reference workflows pass through in-process, stdio, headless socket and native socket; complete binding coverage is separate.

release_scenarios.required_result: Check every registered user action/query against the public catalog; test repeated requests, atomic batch failure, user/agent revision conflicts, undo, job cancellation, disconnect/reconnect, stale readings, and structured dialog decisions; no missing command or result is waived because screenshots could supply a workaround
release_scenarios.assessment: Catalog presence and named conflicts/retries/batches/jobs/decisions are recorded; complete per-capability and platform teardown acceptance remains partial.

formative_study.proposed_gate: At least 8/10 overall and 4/5 newcomers build the LED circuit from blank and obtain a changing current reading within five minutes without facilitator intervention
At least 8/10 correctly predict or explain why increasing resistance reduces LED current after using the tool
At least 8/10 plot capacitor voltage and enter a cursor time without being told where the plot action is
At least 8/10 repair an intentionally disconnected wire and undo an accidental deletion without losing work
At least 9/10 distinguish Running, Paused, and a stale/failed result in prepared scenarios; every observed case of failure presented as valid requires investigation before release
At least 8/10 identify one relevant model limitation and save/reopen the experiment without missing dependencies
